ops.title: WAL checkpoint starvation under parallel sessions
ops.content: When two sessions write concurrently, the TRUNCATE checkpoint starves; symptom is an ever-growing -wal file.

connect_to.title: SQLite write contention
connect_to.why: WAL checkpoint starvation is a direct downstream effect of parallel sessions contending on the WAL writer slot — the writer-slot blockage prevents the TRUNCATE checkpoint from completing, causing the -wal file to grow unboundedly.
